description:
Turn your voice into polished text.

Ultra-fast AI powered dictation that understands what you want to say and how you want to say it. Instantly turn speech into perfect emails, crisp notes, clear messages, professional communication, and more.
## Features
- Whisper models are now free
- Free Pro trial now counted in words instead of minutes
- S1-mini is now generally available
- Tone control for Message, Mail, and Notes modes
- In-app updates for local models
## Improvements
- Faster launch and time to transcription-ready
- Whisper models renamed to Tiny, Base, Small, Medium, and Large
